movelist.name: Lava Plume
movelist.effect: Lava Plume burns all targets on 16+.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Flame Wheel
movelist.effect: Flame Wheel Burns the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Smokescreen
movelist.effect: Smokescreen creates a blast of Smoke that covers the target area; the Smoke persists until the end of the encounter, or until Defog or Whirlwind are used. All targets attacking from or into the Smoke receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy.

movelist.name: Fire Spin
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Rapid Spin
movelist.effect: Rapid Spin destroys all Hazards within 5 meters, removes Leech Seeds, and removes the user’s Trapped or Stuck status. If Rapid Spin hits, the user’s speed raises 1 CS.

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.effect: The user’s Combat Stages, Evasion, or Accuracy may not be lowered except by the user’s own Moves and effects. Defensive.

abilities.name: Shell Armor
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Critical Hits; they are instead normal hits. Defensive.
